name: helix
runtime: window.helix on the studio page. Same-origin frames may post { type: 'helix.run', id, commands } and listen for { type: 'helix.result', id, result }.
units: Metres. Y is up. Yaw is degrees. Heading 0 faces world -Z. W drives, A turns left, D turns right.
write: await helix.run(commands). At most 24 commands. One undo step. Ground, camera, and lights cannot be removed.

commands.does: Remove props. Keeps the stage and the warden.
asset is a catalog id, an exact title, or a unique fragment such as knight.

beats.body: The knight does not move. The chest does.
